title: Prompt Result Review V1 (one human acceptance or refusal of one stored result)
$comment: Written by src/design_lab/prompt_results.py (PromptResults.review). `reviewer_kind` is const 'human' and the table's own CHECK repeats it: owner ruling 2026-10-21 keeps local acceptance human-only, exactly as the outbound candidate approval does, so an agent signature cannot be stored here at all -- and a self-issued agent acceptance would be a second E4 nobody signed. `content_sha256` is copied from the stored row, never from the caller: quoting the bytes the reviewer actually judged is what makes a later recomposition stop being described by this signature, instead of somebody having to remember to clear a flag.
